key_insight: First-principles calculations predict ferroelectric ground states in 11 of 15 [111]-oriented perovskite-oxide superlattices, with octahedral rotations significantly affecting ferroelectricity in some systems.
engineering_relevance: The findings inform polarization and structural design of oxide superlattices, rather than directly demonstrating AI methods or solar-cell performance.
method: Calculate ground-state structures of 15 free-standing oxide superlattices from first principles.
Account for ferroelectric distortions and octahedral rotations described by zone-center phonons.
Compare [111] and [100] thermodynamic stability and analyze force constants.
evidence_signal: Across 15 calculated superlattices, 11 have ferroelectric ground states; the abstract reports no experimental validation or photovoltaic metrics.
watch_item: Predictions for free-standing ground-state structures may not transfer directly to substrate-constrained films or operating devices.
paper_title: Properties of [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices based on oxides with a perovskite structure
